statement: Warren 2026-10-07, budget ledger rules (N0079_PROPOSAL.md plus four improvements): budget is DERIVED (approving a lineup writes reserve rows; nobody types a pot; COMMERCIAL_DOMAIN_RULES 1.1). One append-only ledger at product x customer x landed-quarter grain; rolls up by product line x quarter and customer x quarter; limit check at product line x quarter. Committed = case approve event at ttl_support_usd with FX booked at approval; post-approval edits write adjust rows; cancel writes release. Consumed = case settle event at ttl_result_usd, releasing commitment minus result (rule 1.6). Paid = separate rows from linked payment evidence, shown with link coverage. Transfers between lines/quarters are audited rows by admin or a planner with can_edit on that product line. Campaign and non-campaign reserve are stored as separate rows; an on-screen switch chooses which counts. The 211 settled historical cases are loaded as consumption rows tagged historical_import (proven on a clone before cip). Spend with no reserve shows as flagged 'unplanned spend'; lines with no landed quarter go to an 'unknown quarter' bucket. Optional management caps per product line x quarter: admin-set, audited, over-cap flags and never blocks. Old fact_budget_* tables (0 rows) and hard-delete budget endpoints retire.
